description: This municipal compilation supplies 40 socio-energetic indicators for 11,131 German municipalities. The research team combines census information such as population density, mobility counts such as vehicle ownership, and estimates of renewable-energy potential, including wind. A separate CSV gives achievable hydrothermal temperatures at a stated spatial resolution of 8.5 square kilometres. Figshare provides the municipality table as an Excel workbook and the temperature data as CSV, under CC BY 4.0 with free access. The inspected version 5 metadata describes a static combination of sources, not a uniform observation year or regularly updated time series. These indicators can define local energy-system scenarios, select comparable municipalities and parameterize renewable supply options, complementing the demand profiles in data-when2heat-heat-demand-heat-pump-cop. A caveat is that municipal aggregation and mixed source dates may conceal local constraints or changing boundaries. Reported resource potential is not a guarantee of technically buildable or institutionally permitted capacity. The workbook and temperature table were not downloaded.
